summary.text: Lisa DeMio is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 15, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as business founder.

paragraphs.text: Lisa DeMio was born in Mount Vernon, Ohio, and her professional experience includes owning a small business and raising a family.
She is involved with the Hampstead Democratic Committee, the League of New Hampshire Craftsmen and the American Craft Council.
Ballotpedia's campaign-finance listing records DeMio as having lost the general election for New Hampshire House of Representatives Rockingham 34 in 2020 and Rockingham 15 in 2022 and 2024.
In Ballotpedia surveys, she described herself as a small business owner, a mother and a Granite Stater.
